0.msg: Hello, #b#h0##k. Did you hear that the #bStar Season 13#k started? They say many falling stars are making everyone's wishes come true!

1.msg: I'm always thinking about what gifts totally awesome heroes like you could use. So I decided to hold this #bStar Event#k and #bAttendance Check#k, to make your dreams come true!

2.msg: Collect Star Stamps from the #b[Star Season 13] A Wish Upon A Falling Star#k quest. I will check your attendance for the day when you collect #b5#k Star Stamps.

3.msg: Hm? Do you have to hunt #bmonsters within your level range#k? Ha! Of course not! Just collect the Star Stamps and I'll give you an Attendance Stamp!

4.msg: So, shall we start collecting #bStar Stamps#k?

no.0: This is a golden opportunity. You can attend both the Starlight Festival and the Attendance Check if you collect #bStar Stamps#k.

yes.0: Great! Start collecting those #bStar Stamps#k. You can collect 1 #bStar Stamp#k every #b15 minutes#k by clicking on the star-shaped icon on the left to start the #b[Star Season 13] A Wish Upon A Falling Star#k quest.
